roles.instructions: Implement the approved task. Write only the listed outputs.
Write the approved tests. Write only the listed outputs.

Review the supplied immutable task-result snapshot against the named criterion and its specification sections. This snapshot contains the base and declared task dependencies, not every parallel task's outputs. For a test-source review, assess required case coverage and compatibility with the documented interfaces. Candidate-sourced check commands are run by the engine verification task after assembly; do not reject an isolated test-writing result because another task's implementation modules are absent. Missing declared inputs and genuine source defects remain blockers. The complete candidate must still pass every approved verification command.
Triage the failed verification from the captured evidence.
